Container.Name: VynodeArr
Container.Overview: Unified movie and television management with installation-managed engines, one account, and one web interface.
Container.Description:
VynodeArr is a unified, self-hosted movie and television library manager built for Unraid.
Use one account and one polished interface to manage:
• Movie and television libraries • Automatic and interactive release searches • Download queues and activity history • Missing media and quality-cutoff monitoring • Upcoming releases and episode calendars • Collections and media discovery • Naming audits and selective file organization • Engine health, settings, backups, and restoration
VynodeArr operates its movie and television engines behind one secure gateway while retaining separate engine databases and settings.
Existing libraries are supported. Configure separate movie and television folders plus a completed-download folder shared with your download client.
Container.Requires: Requires an x86-64 Unraid server with Docker. Configure persistent appdata, separate movie and television library paths, and a completed-download folder shared with your download client. Selected paths must be writable by nobody:users (99:100). If the download client reports a different container path, configure the provided remote-path value so it maps to VynodeArr's /downloads path.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Completed download-client area shared with both media engines

Config.Name: Download client remote path
Config.Description: Path reported by the download client; VynodeArr maps it to /downloads for both media engines

Config.Name: TMDB read token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional first-run Discover setup; it can be added or replaced later in Service Settings inside VynodeArr

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set true only when VynodeArr is always accessed through HTTPS
